name: @diagrid/typescript-ai
description: Durable workflow integrations for TypeScript AI agent frameworks

scripts.clean: pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" run clean && node -e "for (const d of ['.tsbuild','coverage']) require('node:fs').rmSync(d,{recursive:true,force:true})"

//devDependencies: The @opentelemetry/* and @grpc/grpc-js entries are here for the test
harness, not for the build: tests/guards/telemetry-compat.test.ts imports
them directly to pin the upstream surface that packages/core loads behind
a dynamic import(). pnpm's isolated node_modules means a dependency of
packages/core is not resolvable from tests/, so the guard needs its own
packages/core. @mastra/core is here for the same reason:
tests/mastra/mapper-real-agent.test.ts maps a genuine Mastra Agent, which is
the only way to catch config that the class keeps private (see that file).
